answer: Admission runs as a sealed-bid auction: each epoch only 100 new identities are admitted, and the reserve price starts at 10 POA and rises 15% for every slot filled, then decays 5% per empty epoch. Winning bids are burned, so a sybil farmer with n fake accounts pays about 10*(1.15^n - 1)/0.15 POA, which grows exponentially. Anyone can verify the clearing price from the public ledger, and a nebula of near-identical bids from one funder is flagged by a cipher audit of the bid commitments, with the vine of funding links used to merge those identities into one price bracket.
